title: From SQL Generation to Tool Selection: A Domain-Oriented Pattern for MCP Servers
abstract: arXiv:2608.22063v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents built on Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly reach enterprise data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and many MCP database servers maximize flexibility by exposing a single generic SQL execution tool. This paper proposes the Domain-Oriented Tooling Pattern: instead of generating SQL at query time, the model selects from a small set of domain-aligned tools whose parameterized queries encapsulate schema navigation, joins and business rules on the server side. We formalize the pattern around three architectural invariants and introduce Model Demotion, the observation that replacing SQL synthesis with intent classification lowers the model tier required to serve routine requests. As a reference implementation we present MCP Blueprint, an open-source framework in which domain tools are defined declaratively as YAML metadata plus external parameterized SQL files. translated_title: 从SQL生成到工具选择：面向MCP服务器的领域导向模式
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22063v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的代理越来越多地通过模型上下文协议（MCP）访问企业数据，许多MCP数据库服务器通过暴露单一通用SQL执行工具来最大化灵活性。本文提出了领域导向工具模式：不在查询时生成SQL，而是让模型从一小组领域对齐的工具中选择，这些工具的参数化查询在服务器端封装了模式导航、连接和业务规则。我们围绕三个架构不变量形式化该模式，并引入模型降级概念，即用意图分类替代SQL合成可降低服务常规请求所需的模型层级。作为参考实现，我们展示了MCP Blueprint，一个开源框架，其中领域工具以YAML元数据加外部参数化SQL文件声明式定义。我们使用公共可复现基准评估该模式。
tldr: 本文提出领域导向工具模式，通过预定义参数化SQL工具替代实时SQL生成，降低模型层级需求，并开源MCP Blueprint框架实现该模式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a domain-oriented tooling pattern that replaces real-time SQL generation with predefined parameterized SQL tools, reducing model tier requirements, and open-sources the MCP Blueprint framework implementing this pattern.
